_doc: Fail-safe allowlist for Medic's PR2 reversible action handlers in scripts/medic_actions.py. This is the ONLY set of targets Medic may mutate; a target not listed here is REFUSED and Medic escalates a diagnose-only report instead of acting on an arbitrary unit. restart_daemon_units: the watchdog-supervised daemon units Medic may restart via 'sudo -n systemctl restart <unit>' -- mirrors scripts/watchdog.py AUTO_RESTART_SERVICES, the only units the watchdog itself auto-restarts. retrigger_inbox_targets: the inbox-stall remediation target -- the existing re-trigger mechanism in this repo IS restarting the inbox-watcher (scripts/watchdog.py check_inbox_watcher), so a stalled inbox is re-triggered by restarting ourliberty-inbox-watcher.service. silenceable_subjects: substring patterns of alert fingerprints (source:subject) that Medic's silence-false-positive handler may durably suppress WITHOUT DMing Larry, but ONLY after its read-only investigation confirms the specific fingerprint is benign (e.g. a forge-no-pr alert whose build shipped under a re-keyed branch -- the 2026-06-04 forge-queue-api case). A fingerprint matching no pattern is REFUSED. Seed ONLY classes proven to produce benign false positives; the durable healer-side reconciliation (e.g. _preflight_family_shipped) is always the preferred fix, this is the backstop. A silence is reversible via larry_alerts.unsilence. Seeded conservatively. Missing or malformed file is treated as an EMPTY allowlist -- Medic can act on/silence nothing -- fail safe, never raises. Unit names carry the full .service suffix.
